headline: Last session: Sensex and Nifty snapped two-week winning streak, falling 2% weekly as crude oil prices surged

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Tuesday, 27 October.

why: Crude oil prices surged to $117 per barrel, dragging down Indian shares
Profit booking occurred after the market had enjoyed a two-week winning streak
Heavy selling pressure was observed in major stocks like Adani Enterprises
Concerns over global cues and rising energy costs impacted investor sentiment
whatHappening: Nifty 50 closed the last session at 22,600 while the Sensex fell 125 points
IDFC First Bank reported a 197% rise in Q2 PAT to ₹1,045 crore on lower provisions
IT stocks saw buying interest, helping the indices rebound from their intraday lows
IRDAI extended the feedback window for proposed insurance distribution reforms
summary: On the last trading day, Indian indices snapped a two-week winning streak as surging crude oil prices hit $117 per barrel. IDFC First Bank reported a significant 197% rise in quarterly profits, while Adani Enterprises led the weekly losers. The market is currently closed for the weekend and will resume trading on Tuesday.
